items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: In other words, the first band did not have Bill Harris or Chubby. But it did have Sam Stan in lead alto and --

ctx.x: I see. Okay. In that band, now, what did you feel was significantly exciting compared with the first one? It had its own brand of excitement and had some of the carry-overs, some of the key people.
Yeah. The carryover people, with rare exceptions, came back later. In other words, the first band did not have Bill Harris or Chubby. But it did have Sam Stan in lead alto and --
